name: Hitting Size / Shattering-Cover Projection VC Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the common-core cube $\mathcal Q^{\cap}_n$, $\mathrm{SCVC}=n$ while $\mathrm{HT}=1$.
proof: The singleton and common-core-cube calculations give unbounded gaps in the two opposite directions.
